_note: Beastman culture: ORCS, the brutal raider-soldiers and the archetypal beastman. Their speech is KAZHUR (the sorcerers' maker-tongue, family_beastman.json) rotted into deep guttural GROWLS - q -> ghr/khr, kh -> KHR, heavy gr/rk/gh, drawn-out growl, suffixes -gur/-rakh/-gor - over a faint, still-recognizable Kazhur skeleton (qatal 'kill' -> Khatakhgur). Concepts are few and brutal (blood, meat, kill, fire, dark, totem). ALWAYS CHAOTIC. Faith is TOTEMIC shamanism: the race-totem is the Red Maw / the Tusked War-Boar; the kashap (shaman) serves it and, above all the served Chaos-Spirits, Gul-Maraqus the great War-Spirit, by blood-offering on the skull-heap; the One (Aternu the Sky-Tyrant) and the Lawful powers are demonized. DEITY names are harsh Kazhur morphs of the Agrippan canon prefixed Gul- (never real gods), no gendered ending (degraded); totem-spirits are descriptive bestial Kazhur, not canon-morphs. Mechanically the beastman tier stays stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Orc (Kazhur, deep-growl regression): q -> ghr/khr, kh -> KHR, heavy clusters gr/rk/gh/khr, drawn-out guttural growl, suffixes -gur/-rakh/-gor; the Kazhur triliteral root stays faintly under the growl. Brutal, loud, throaty.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC/CVCC with heavy guttural clusters and growled codas; root stress, growled length.

morphology.naming_marker: named by the kashap at a blooding; a deed or trait, growled.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / wandering horde (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

shaman_line.high_shaman: Rakh-Khashagh (great-shaman; keeper of the horde's great-totem)

religion._note: CHAOTIC only. TOTEMIC shamanism: the orc race-totem is the RED MAW / the Tusked War-Boar; tribes also take totems. The kashap serves the totem and the Chaos-Spirits (the Gul-spirits) by blood-offering on the skull-heap; above all Gul-Maraqus the great War-Spirit (orcs are made for slaughter). The One and the Lawful are demonized and feared. Deity-morphs take the Gul- prefix and no gendered ending (degraded); totems are descriptive bestial Kazhur, not canon-morphs.
religion.race_totem: the Red Maw (Dhamr-Megargh, the red devouring jaws) / the Tusked War-Boar (Khargan-Behgur)

venerated.Maraxus (war-fire, slaughter): Gul-Maraqus (the great War-Spirit; served above all)
venerated.Noctiluna (the night-cover): Gul-Naktilu (the Dark that hides the horde)

religion.tribal_totem_pattern: [Rakh-/Dhamr-/Khashak-/color] + [beast or body-part]: Rakh-Shengur (the Great Fang), Dhamr-Tsibgar (the Blood-Claw), Khashak-Behgur (the Dark-Beast).
religion.shaman_rites: blood-offering on the skull-heap, the totem-pole and the boar-skull standard, the donning of the totem's hide; the Rakh-Khashagh keeps the horde's great-totem.
